deadline.value: Priority deadline December 1, 2026 for fall (spring: August 1); later applications are reviewed on a space-available basis.

gre_general.value: The Fulton Schools of Engineering say the GRE is required for PhD programs (the program page itself does not list it); at-home GRE not accepted.
gre_general.quote: GRE is required for PHD programs.

also.quote: and high GRE and TOEFL scores

gre_subject.value: Engineering has no GRE Subject test; nothing stated.

supervisor.value: The program pages do not say whether you need a faculty advisor before admission.

funding.value: Funding is not described on the program page; admission is highly competitive.

entry_route.value: A bachelor's or master's qualifies; preferred backgrounds are aerospace or mechanical engineering, with GPA 3.25+.
entry_route.quote: Applicants must have earned a bachelor's or master's degree from an accredited U.S. or international institution.

also.quote: Admission to the mechanical engineering doctoral program is highly competitive, and preferred applicants have an undergraduate or Master of Science degree in aerospace engineering or mechanical engineering.

notes: Separate Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering PhDs share the same December 1 priority deadline and 3.25 GPA minimum.
name: Mechanical Engineering PhD / Aerospace Engineering PhD
